cookies.title: Your cookie choice
cookies.body: We use necessary cookies to run the site. With your OK, we also count visits and which link brought you.
cookies.sheetIntro: Optional cookies stay off until you accept them. Change this any time from the page footer.
cookies.necessaryBody: Keep you signed in and remember choices like language and mode.
cookies.attributionBody: Records which link or campaign brought you here.
cookies.measurementBody: Counts visits and pages so we can improve the site.
cookies.together: Both optional kinds are accepted or rejected together.
cookies.currentUnset: No choice yet. Optional cookies are off.
